payload.summary: Planned a contract-first correlation spine for every meaningful backend operation and a production GX-10 runtime sized for a 1 TB disk. PostgreSQL remains the bounded durable operation index while Langfuse holds masked detailed traces; Railway data cutover remains a separate change.
completed_work: Created proposal, eleven strict delta specs, design with twelve decisions, machine-readable OpenAPI/SQL/event contracts, generated type stubs, TDD task plan, and coordinated work-package DAG.
Passed strict OpenSpec, JSON syntax, work-package schema, DAG, lock canonicalization, scope-overlap, and architecture-zone validation.

decisions.title: Use a dual-layer correlation spine
decisions.rationale: PostgreSQL preserves restart-safe identifiers and outcomes while Langfuse holds detailed spans without creating a second workflow state machine.

decisions.title: Key attempts by claim generation
decisions.rationale: Stored W3C context and claim fencing preserve retry and restart topology without holding queue spans open in memory.

decisions.title: Start with complete controlled traces
decisions.rationale: One hundred percent meaningful-operation coverage plus export-time masking establishes a trustworthy baseline before any measured sampling policy.

decisions.title: Govern the GX-10 as production infrastructure
decisions.rationale: Pinned services, private networks, quotas, watermarks, backups, restore drills, and environment fencing are required before local primary operation.

decisions.title: Keep Railway cutover separate
decisions.rationale: This change builds and validates observability plus local topology but does not broaden authority into data migration or traffic switching.

next_steps: Repair coordinator credentials and re-register the planned lock keys from work-packages.yaml.
At Gate 2 approval, seed coordinator implementation tasks and begin wp-contracts.
Do not migrate Railway data or switch traffic in this change.

relevant_files.description: OpenAPI, SQL, event, and type contracts
